headline: Mubadala Capital Announces Tender Offer to Increase Stake in Kepler Weber
summary: Mubadala Capital announced a public tender offer to acquire up to 35% of Kepler Weber, Latin America's largest grain storage equipment maker, at R$7.50 per share.
why: Kepler Weber is a prominent Brazilian manufacturer of agricultural storage systems serving the region's massive agribusiness sector.

impacts.name: Kepler Weber SA
impacts.why: A public tender offer at a premium directly increases demand and valuation for target shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A takeover offer for a controlling stake typically drives share prices toward the offer valuation.
